title: I'm learning Italian, so I've spent 83 days building a cozy Sardinian village where everyone only speaks Italian
author: London2022
selftext:
It's a project derived from passion for this beautiful language. 

I don't mind sharing as I am building it primarily for me as an intermediate Italian learner. If it helps others, that is a bonus!

  
I want to make Italian fun and easy to learn. I gew up playing video games across all genres, so am pouring my heart and soul into this. 

Initially started with Fable 5, used Codex for a bit, but then used Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5. 

I would say it is a year out from being completed (minimum). 

Feel free to ask any questions!

comments.author: AssistBorn4589
comments.body: Sorry but that's all Greek to me, basically a Spanish village.
